get.description: Medications you can order in the current mode. Prices are in cents. `requirements` names the optional prescription fields this pharmacy requires; `compoundingReasons` and `quantities` list the accepted values when the pharmacy limits them, counted in `quantityUnit` (a quantity of 1 for a vial is 1 mL). `pharmacyId` lists only that pharmacy's medications, and `name` only those with exactly that name: one medication's strengths, forms and pharmacies.

post.description: One request creates the order, signs it and sends it to the pharmacy. With an API key, name the prescriber and send signatureAttestation. In the app, the signed-in member signs with the NPI in their settings. The patient is found by patient.externalId and updated from the order. Live orders require a default card or bank account on the payer (the platform for its practices); otherwise 409 payment_method_required is returned before creating an order.
post.summary: Create, sign and submit an order

post.description: Queue failed order event deliveries from the last 30 days for this endpoint. Only the current organization and mode apply. The worker retries each delivery up to 12 times with the same event ID and payload. Delivered, pending, and test events stay unchanged. Send a unique Idempotency-Key for each request. Reuse that key after an uncertain response to return the original count. A new request queues only deliveries that are still failed.

apiKey.description: An API key from the Affinity dashboard. Test and Live keys act in their mode.
